docs.speaker: Caroline

docs.text: Wow, cool! How did it go? Did you learn anything cool?

docs.text: Learning new programming stuff is great. Did you find any ideas that you'll incorporate into your own work?

docs.text: No worries, James. I hope they help. Let me know if you have any questions.

docs.text: I'll reach out if I need help. Thanks for the resources, really appreciate it. By the way, my mother came to see me with her army friend two days ago. We had fun. [image: a photo of a man and woman in military clothing standing next to a dog]

docs.text: Wow, James! Those games really sparked your passion for gaming, didn't they?

docs.text: Thank you very much, I will definitely keep this in mind!

docs.text: Hey James! That sounds awesome! I had a super fun weekend - I worked with a game developer on a project and it was great to see my ideas come to life. It was an incredible experience!  [image: a photo of a wooden board game with four pieces of wood and four pieces of colored balls]

docs.text: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together.
